name: Secret Garden
description: David Attenborough reveals the drama unfolding in the hidden wild world of Britain's backyards. Because even in familiar surroundings, the rules of the wild are still in force.

videos.title: Oxfordshire
videos.overview: The lives of the kingfishers, otters, and other animals in a river garden. Life here seems idyllic, but all are at the mercy of seasonal floods.

videos.title: Bristol
videos.overview: The hidden lives of foxes, hedgehogs, blue tits, and frogs, each making a life for themselves in a small urban garden in Bristol.

videos.title: The Lake District
videos.overview: The hidden struggles of swallows, field mice, newts, and moles as they race to breed in a beautiful country garden in Cumbria.

videos.title: The Wye Valley
videos.overview: How tawny owls, badgers, dormice, and bumblebees have made a home in a beautiful woodland garden hidden at the bottom of a steep-sided Welsh valley.

videos.title: The Western Highlands
videos.overview: How a remote garden on Scotland’s west coast has become an oasis for barn owls and pine martens as they battle the elements to feed, breed, and survive.
